zoe: Heads-up: discovered an unexpected token shortfall for 2026-04-11 00:30-03:30 UTC after weekly reconcile ran. Posting quick plan.
mason: Can you paste top customer ids? I'll run a scoped diff.
zoe: Uploaded top-50 CSV to the shared drive. Hypothesis: late S3 partition writes + consumer restart during compaction.
tara: I'll own customer comms and credit template. ETA tomorrow 09:00 PT.
ledger-bot: Alert MTR-2026-11: ledger.apply_rate dropped 45% at 00:45 UTC; potential backlog.
mason: Quick SQL to find deficits (adjust times):
```sql
SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(r.tokens) - COALESCE(SUM(l.tokens),0) AS deficit
FROM raw_events r
LEFT JOIN ledger_events l ON r.event_id = l.event_id
JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE r.event_ts >= '2026-04-11T00:30:00Z' AND r.event_ts < '2026-04-11T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING deficit > 0
ORDER BY deficit DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
zoe: Short-term: run controlled backfill dry-run -> validate deltas -> apply with rate cap. Also add a weekly reconciliation job.
mason: I'll run dry-run tonight with --dry-run --idempotency-key=pm-2213456789 and produce delta CSV. ETA 2026-04-12 02:00 PT.
tara: owned | drafting comms + FAQ; will include escalation paths for Tier A accounts.
infra-bot: Note: autoscaler churn at 00:42 UTC correlated with pod restarts. We increased batch-consumer memory as mitigation.

1) Controlled dry-run + delta CSV -> mason -> ETA 2026-04-12 02:00 PT
2) Apply backfill (if validated) -> mason -> ETA 2026-04-12 08:00 PT

4) Telemetry: ingest.lag_seconds & dedupe.discard_rate alerts -> zoe -> ETA 2026-04-14
5) Runbook updates (replay/abort) -> mason/infra -> ETA 2026-04-15

zoe: Longer-term: add a scheduled reconciliation that diffs raw_events -> ledger daily and fires a pager when deltas exceed threshold. mason, can you prototype next sprint?
